exams.name: DSST A History of the Vietnam War
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering the origins, escalation, conduct and aftermath of the Vietnam War, normally worth three credits.

exams.name: DSST Art of the Western World
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test surveying Western art and architecture from classical Greece through twentieth-century movements.

exams.name: DSST Astronomy
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the solar system, stellar evolution, galaxies and cosmology at introductory college level.

exams.name: DSST Business Ethics and Society
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on ethical theory, corporate social responsibility, governance and stakeholder issues in business.

exams.name: DSST Business Mathematics
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on applied business calculations including interest, discounts, depreciation, payroll and financial ratios.

exams.name: DSST Computing and Information Technology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering computer hardware, software, networking, databases and information technology fundamentals.

exams.name: DSST Criminal Justice
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering policing, courts, corrections and the structure of the American criminal justice system.

exams.name: DSST Environmental Science
aka: Environment and Humanity: The Race to Save the Planet
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on ecosystems, resource use, pollution, energy and environmental policy, formerly titled Environment and Humanity.

exams.name: DSST Ethics in America
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on major ethical traditions and their application to contemporary moral problems in American life.

exams.name: DSST Ethics in Technology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on privacy, intellectual property, computer crime and professional responsibility in technology work.

exams.name: DSST Foundations of Education
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on the history, philosophy, organisation and legal framework of American schooling.

exams.name: DSST Fundamentals of College Algebra
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on linear and quadratic equations, inequalities, functions, exponents and logarithms.

exams.name: DSST Fundamentals of Counseling
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on counselling theories, the helping relationship, assessment and professional ethics.

exams.name: DSST Fundamentals of Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on threats, cryptography, network defence, risk management and security governance concepts.

exams.name: DSST General Anthropology
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering physical anthropology, archaeology, linguistics and cultural anthropology as four subfields.

exams.name: DSST Health and Human Development
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on nutrition, fitness, disease prevention, mental health and substance use across the lifespan.

exams.name: DSST History of the Soviet Union
aka: Rise and Fall of the Soviet Union
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test covering Russian revolution, Stalinism, the Cold War and the collapse of the Soviet state in 1991.

exams.name: DSST Human Resource Management
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on recruitment, selection, training, compensation, labour relations and employment law.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to Business
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test surveying business forms, management, marketing, finance and the economic environment of firms.

exams.name: DSST Introduction to Geography
exams.blurb: DANTES subject standardized test on population, culture, settlement, economic activity and regional geography, formerly Human Cultural Geography.
